sources.theme/fonts.toml:
[fonts]
general = "Noto Sans"
nerd    = "Hack Nerd Font Mono"

[sizes]
terminal  = 13
interface = 13

obsidian = true
sources.theme/roles.toml:
[roles]

# fastfetch
section_system   = "ansi_blue_text_on_canvas"
section_hardware = "bright_ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas"
section_desktop  = "ansi_magenta_text_on_canvas"
section_network  = "ansi_green_text_on_canvas"
separator        = "border_on_canvas"

# starship
prompt_python   = "bright_ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas"
prompt_git      = "ansi_green_text_on_canvas"
prompt_dir      = "ansi_cyan_text_on_canvas"
prompt_duration = "ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas"
prompt_char     = "ansi_blue_text_on_canvas"

sudo = "error_text_on_canvas" # shell

[terminal]
foreground           = "text_on_canvas"
background           = "canvas_bg"
cursor               = "cursor"
cursor_text          = "cursor_text"
selection_foreground = "on_primary"
selection_background = "primary_fill"
url                  = "info_text_on_canvas"

[eza]
fi = "muted_on_canvas"           # fallback
di = "ansi_blue_text_on_canvas"  # directories
ex = "ansi_green_text_on_canvas" # executables
ln = "ansi_cyan_text_on_canvas"  # symlinks

"*.toml" = "bright_ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas"
"*.json" = "ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas"
"*.lock" = "border_on_canvas"
"*.sh"   = "ansi_green_text_on_canvas"

[eza.categories]
image    = "ansi_magenta_text_on_canvas"
video    = "bright_ansi_magenta_text_on_canvas"
audio    = "ansi_cyan_text_on_canvas"
archive  = "ansi_red_text_on_canvas"
document = "bright_ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas"
source   = "ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas"
config   = "bright_ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas"
markup   = "bright_ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas"
data     = "bright_ansi_red_text_on_canvas"
web      = "bright_ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas"
temp     = "border_on_canvas"
compiled = "border_on_canvas"

[kde]
accent = "primary_fill"

window_bg   = "canvas_bg"
window_alt  = "panel_bg"
button_bg   = "surface_fill"
button_alt  = "panel_bg"
view_bg     = "canvas_bg"
view_alt    = "panel_bg"
tooltip_bg  = "surface_fill"
tooltip_alt = "panel_bg"
header_bg   = "panel_bg"
header_alt  = "canvas_bg"

selection_bg = "primary_fill"
selection_fg = "on_primary"

foreground = "ui.foreground"
inactive   = "disabled_on_canvas"
active     = "ui.primary"
link       = "ansi.normal.blue"
visited    = "ansi.normal.magenta"
negative   = "ansi.normal.red"
neutral    = "ansi.normal.yellow"
positive   = "ansi.normal.green"
decoration = "ui.primary"

# window manager titlebar
wm_active_bg      = "canvas_bg"
wm_active_fg      = "text_on_canvas"
wm_active_blend   = "text_on_canvas"
wm_inactive_bg    = "panel_bg"
wm_inactive_fg    = "disabled_on_panel"
wm_inactive_blend = "disabled_on_panel"

[konsole]
tab          = "canvas_bg"
focus_border = "focus_ring"
tab_activity = "text_on_canvas"

name = "Catppuccin Latte"
dark = false

[ui] # Mandatory
background = "#eff1f5" # Main background / Secondary-Sidebar- Colors
primary    = "#dd7878" # Active / Highlight / Primary- Colors
accent     = "#e6e8ee" # Sidebar Background / Support- Colors
surface    = "#d5d7df" # Dimmed / Border- Colors
foreground = "#4c4f69" # Text colors / brightest foreground

[ansi.normal] # Mandatory

red     = "#d20f39"
green   = "#40a02b"
yellow  = "#df8e1d"
blue    = "#1e66f5"

cyan    = "#179299"
white   = "#5c5f77"

[ansi.bright] # Mandatory

green   = "#459042"

white   = "#4c4f69"

{
  "$schema": "https://github.com/fastfetch-cli/fastfetch/raw/master/doc/json_schema.json",

  "display": {
    "constants": [
      // theme:constants
      "\u001b[1;38;2;129;161;193m", // ansi_blue_text_on_canvas #81a1c1
      "\u001b[1;38;2;235;203;139m", // bright_ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas #ebcb8b
      "\u001b[1;38;2;180;142;173m", // ansi_magenta_text_on_canvas #b48ead
      "\u001b[1;38;2;163;190;140m", // ansi_green_text_on_canvas #a3be8c
      "\u001b[38;2;97;98;121m" // border_on_canvas #616279
      // theme:constants:end
    ],
    "separator": "  ",
    "key": { "width": 14 },
    "color": { "separator": "#616279" }, // theme:separator
    "size": { "binaryPrefix": "jedec", "ndigits": 0 },
    "percent": { "type": 9, "green": 50, "yellow": 80 }
  },

  "logo": {
    "type": "file-raw",
    "source": "~/.config/fastfetch/arch.txt",
    "padding": { "top": 6, "left": 3, "right": 5 }
  },

  "modules": [
    "break",

    { "type": "title", "format": "{$1}{user-name}{$4} @ {$3}{host-name}" },
    { "type": "custom", "format": "{$5}───────────────────────────────" },
    "break",

    { "type": "custom", "format": "{$1}  SYSTEM" },
    { "type": "os", "key": "{$1}󰣇  OS" },
    { "type": "kernel", "key": "{$1}󰌽  Kernel" },
    { "type": "uptime", "key": "{$1}󰅐  Uptime" },
    { "type": "packages", "key": "{$1}󰏗  Packages" },
    { "type": "shell", "key": "{$1}󰆍  Shell" },
    "break",

    { "type": "custom", "format": "{$2}  HARDWARE" },
    { "type": "cpu", "key": "{$2}󰻠  CPU" },
    { "type": "gpu", "key": "{$2}󰢮  GPU", "hideType": "integrated" },
    {
      "type": "memory",
      "key": "{$2}󰍛  Memory",
      "format": "{used} / {total} [{percentage}]"
    },
    {
      "type": "disk",
      "key": "{$2}󰋊  Disk",
      "folders": "/:/home",
      "format": "{mountpoint}  {size-used} / {size-total} [{size-percentage}]"
    },
    "break",

    { "type": "custom", "format": "{$3}  DESKTOP" },
    { "type": "de", "key": "{$3}󰧨  DE" },
    { "type": "wm", "key": "{$3}󰖯  WM" },
    { "type": "terminal", "key": "{$3}󰆌  Terminal" },
    { "type": "theme", "key": "{$3}󰏘  Theme", "format": "{theme1}" },
    { "type": "display", "key": "{$3}󰍹  Display" },
    "break",

    { "type": "custom", "format": "{$4}  NETWORK" },
    { "type": "locale", "key": "{$4}󰗊  Locale" },
    "break",

    { "type": "colors", "symbol": "circle", "paddingLeft": 2 }
  ]
}

add_newline = false
palette     = 'theme'

format = '$python$git_branch$directory$character'

right_format = '$cmd_duration'

[python]
format            = '[\(.venv\)](prompt_python)$git_branch$directory$character'
symbol            = ''
style             = 'prompt_python'
detect_extensions = []
detect_files      = []
detect_folders    = []

[git_branch]
format = '[\[$branch\]]($style)'
style  = 'prompt_git'

[directory]
format            = '[\[$path\]]($style)'
style             = 'prompt_dir'
truncation_length = 8
truncate_to_repo  = false

[cmd_duration]
min_time = 2000
format   = 'took [$duration]($style)'
style    = 'prompt_duration'

[character]

sources.linux/common/quicklaunch/config.toml:
[window]
width       = 640
max_results = 8
radius      = 16
row_height  = 52
opacity     = 0.96

[behavior]
opening_animation      = false
close_on_click_outside = true
close_on_focus_loss    = true
frequency_ranking      = true

[theme]
source = "custom"
# theme:quicklaunch
# Generated from theme/profiles/sexy-purple.toml
accent     = "#380d6a"
background = "#15152b"
text       = "#ffffff"
muted      = "#737484"
selection  = "#380d6a"
# theme:quicklaunch:end

[font]
size = 20

[icons]
size = 40

{
  "$schema": "https://github.com/fastfetch-cli/fastfetch/raw/master/doc/json_schema.json",

  "display": {
    "constants": [
      // theme:constants
      "\u001b[1;38;2;27;99;242m", // ansi_blue_text_on_canvas #1b63f2
      "\u001b[1;38;2;190;72;0m", // bright_ansi_yellow_text_on_canvas #be4800
      "\u001b[1;38;2;136;57;239m", // ansi_magenta_text_on_canvas #8839ef
      "\u001b[1;38;2;32;127;0m", // ansi_green_text_on_canvas #207f00
      "\u001b[38;2;137;139;147m" // border_on_canvas #898b93
      // theme:constants:end
    ],
    "separator": "  ",
    "key": { "width": 14 },
    "color": { "separator": "#898b93" }, // theme:separator
    "size": { "binaryPrefix": "jedec", "ndigits": 0 },
    "percent": { "type": 9, "green": 50, "yellow": 80 }
  },

  "logo": {
    "type": "file-raw",
    "source": "~/.config/fastfetch/arch.txt",
    "padding": { "top": 6, "left": 3, "right": 5 }
  },

  "modules": [
    "break",

    { "type": "title", "format": "{$1}{user-name}{$4} @ {$3}{host-name}" },
    { "type": "custom", "format": "{$5}───────────────────────────────" },
    "break",

    { "type": "custom", "format": "{$1}  SYSTEM" },
    { "type": "os", "key": "{$1}󰣇  OS" },
    { "type": "kernel", "key": "{$1}󰌽  Kernel" },
    { "type": "uptime", "key": "{$1}󰅐  Uptime" },
    { "type": "packages", "key": "{$1}󰏗  Packages" },
    { "type": "shell", "key": "{$1}󰆍  Shell" },
    "break",

    { "type": "custom", "format": "{$2}  HARDWARE" },

    {
      "type": "memory",

      "format": "{mountpoint}  {size-used} / {size-total} [{size-percentage}]"

    "break",

    { "type": "custom", "format": "{$3}  DESKTOP" },

    "break",

    { "type": "custom", "format": "{$4}  NETWORK" },
    { "type": "locale", "key": "{$4}󰗊  Locale" },
    "break",

    { "type": "colors", "symbol": "circle", "paddingLeft": 2 }
